verdict.rationale: Railway documents programmatic control through an official CLI and an MCP server that lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables and redeploy services. However, the pack never mentions a documented public API itself, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a public HTTP/GraphQL API, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or schema), API authentication/token docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform via API.
